Higashio Osamu Kanshuu Pro Yakyuu Stadiu.name: Higashio Osamu Kanshuu: Pro Yakyuu Stadium '91
Higashio Osamu Kanshuu Pro Yakyuu Stadiu.summary: Higashio Osamu Kanshuu Pro Yakyuu Stadium '91 is a Sports game, published by Tokuma Shoten, which was released on the Game Boy in Japan in 1991.

Momotarou Collection 2.name: Momotaro Collection 2
Momotarou Collection 2.summary: Two more classic Momotarou games on one cartridge.

Shanghai Pocket.name: Shanghai Pocket
Shanghai Pocket.summary: Shanghai Pocket is a Puzzle game, developed and published by SunSoft. It was first released for the Game Boy, then ported to the WonderSwan. The Game Boy version has Super Game Boy support.
